#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class NumberTheory {
public:
    static const long long MOD = 998244353;

    static long long add(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a + b;
        return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
    }

    static long long subtract(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a - b;
        return v < 0 ? v + MOD : v;
    }

    static long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }

    static long long mult(long long a, long long b, long long c) {
        return mult(mult(a, b), c);
    }

    static long long mult(long long a, long long b, long long c, long long d) {
        return mult(mult(a, b), mult(c, d));
    }

    static long long inv(long long value) {
        long long g = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
        for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
            long long q = g / r;
            g %= r;
            long long temp = g;
            g = r;
            r = temp;
            x -= q * y;
            temp = x;
            x = y;
            y = temp;
        }
        return (x % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
    }

    static long long smallInv(int n, const vector<long long>& fact, const vector<long long>& invFact) {
        return mult(invFact[n], fact[n - 1]);
    }

    static long long ncr(int n, int r, const vector<long long>& fact, const vector<long long>& invFact) {
        if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
        return mult(fact[n], mult(invFact[r], invFact[n - r]));
    }

    static void precomputeFact(int n, vector<long long>& fact, vector<long long>& invFact) {
        fact.resize(n + 1);
        invFact.resize(n + 1);
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fact[i] = mult(fact[i - 1], i);
        }
        invFact[n] = inv(fact[n]);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact[i] = mult(invFact[i + 1], i + 1);
        }
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    BufferedReader reader;
    StringTokenizer tokenizer;

    InputReader(istream& stream) : reader(stream) {}

    string next() {
        while (!tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
            string line;
            if (!getline(reader.getStream(), line)) {
                throw runtime_error("Unexpected end of input");
            }
            tokenizer = StringTokenizer(line);
        }
        return tokenizer.nextToken();
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

private:
    class BufferedReader {
    public:
        istream& stream;
        BufferedReader(istream& s) : stream(s) {}
        istream& getStream() { return stream; }
    };

    class StringTokenizer {
    public:
        vector<string> tokens;
        size_t index;

        StringTokenizer(const string& str) {
            istringstream iss(str);
            string token;
            while (iss >> token) {
                tokens.push_back(token);
            }
            index = 0;
        }

        bool hasMoreTokens() {
            return index < tokens.size();
        }

        string nextToken() {
            if (!hasMoreTokens()) throw runtime_error("No more tokens");
            return tokens[index++];
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    vector<long long> fact, invFact;
    NumberTheory::precomputeFact(n + m, fact, invFact);

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = NumberTheory::mult(p, n - i, NumberTheory::smallInv(n + m - i, fact, invFact));
        phaseSize = NumberTheory::add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long term = NumberTheory::mult(
            NumberTheory::ncr(n, k, fact, invFact),
            (m + k),
            NumberTheory::smallInv(k, fact, invFact),
            phaseSize
        );

        if (k % 2 == 1)
            answer = NumberTheory::add(answer, term);
        else
            answer = NumberTheory::subtract(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << endl;

    return 0;
}
